title: Minimum Time to Make Rope Colorful
summary: Alice has a sequence of balloons colored by a string.
statement: Alice has a sequence of balloons colored by a string. Bob must remove some balloons so no two consecutive ones share a color. Each balloon has a removal cost. Calculate the least total cost for Bob to achieve a colorful rope.
constraints: Remove balloons so adjacent remaining balloons never share a color.
Removing position i costs needed_time[i]; minimize total cost.
reference_solution:
def minimum_colorful_rope_removal(colors, needed_time):
 answer=0;index=0
 while index<len(colors):
  end=index+1;total=needed_time[index];largest=needed_time[index]
  while end<len(colors) and colors[end]==colors[index]:total+=needed_time[end];largest=max(largest,needed_time[end]);end+=1
  answer+=total-largest;index=end
 return answer

At least all but one balloon in that run must be removed.
Keep the balloon with greatest removal cost and pay the run total minus that maximum.
Runs become separated by other colors, so their optimal choices are independent.
